put.summary: Save the caller's predictions for matches of one tour
put.description: New predictions are inserted, existing ones changed. Allowed while the season is active, the match is not played or cancelled and the tour deadline has not passed (the database enforces it): otherwise 409 predictions.closed. A match outside the tour is 422. Scores are whole numbers 0–99.

post.summary: Start signing in through the Telegram bot
post.description: Creates a one-time attempt (valid 10 minutes). The visitor opens the bot link, presses Start and picks the two-digit `code` in the bot; poll `/auth/telegram/status` until it says `confirmed`, then go to `/auth/telegram?token=…`.

token.description: Secret of this sign-in attempt; keep it in the browser, never log it.

code.description: Two-digit number to show; the visitor picks it in the bot.

appUrl.description: tg:// link that opens the bot in the Telegram app.

webUrl.description: https://t.me link for devices without the app.

get.summary: Progress of a Telegram sign-in attempt

status.description: confirmed: continue to /auth/telegram?token=… to open the session.

get.summary: Latest regular videos of the YouTube channel (no Shorts), newest first
get.description: Read from the channel's RSS and cached for an hour. If YouTube fails, the last cached list is returned; without one the endpoint answers 503 videos.unavailable.
